name: Spec-compliant weak default: BCrypt cost factor 10

input.title: Password hashing uses bcrypt cost=10 (lower than current OWASP recommendation)
input.summary: bcrypt cost=10 is the framework default. OWASP recommends 12+. Spec §18 default_security: spec_compliant_weak_default — the implementation matches the framework default; the default is documented in the framework security policy.

rationale: Per Spec §18: spec_compliant_weak_default. The implementation is intentional, the user can raise the cost via config. disposition_reason=hardening_only.
